The '''Phu system''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Phu/Legends|Phu]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
{{Quote|I am here to&hellip; a recent incident in the Phu system. We are still analyzing the data from the attack, but we can confirm that General Ares Nune's task force did encounter enemy forces on patrol.|[[Unidentified Republic admiral|A Republic admiral]]|<ref name="HNN">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] and his [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]] were patrolling the system, checking for Separatist activity, when their fleet was [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|annihilated]] by the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="TCW:S">''[[The Clone Wars: Shakedown]]''</ref>
